# Draft cover letter

Dear Editors,

Please consider the enclosed manuscript, “When Does a Physical Property
Survive Representation Change? Uniform Recovery, Spectral Rigidity, and the
Yang--Mills Chain.”

The paper asks what must be shown before a property made manifest in one
description counts as established across a chain of physical
representations. It develops a property-relative certificate calculus that
separates exact preservation, quantitative fidelity, forgetting, theorem-
backed recovery, and uniformity. Its formal core proves that convergence of
positive semigroup quadratic forms on a dense centered recovered core,
together with one index-independent exponential rate, excludes target
spectrum below that rate. Exact countermodels isolate failures caused by an
incomplete core, collapsing finite-index gaps, and noncommuting cutoff and
volume limits.

Yang--Mills theory supplies the principal case study because locality, gauge
invariance, positivity, scale dependence, continuum coherence, and spectral
interpretation are naturally exposed in different representations. The paper
uses that chain to derive methodological proof obligations. It does not claim
to construct four-dimensional continuum Yang--Mills theory or prove its mass
gap.

The manuscript is original, is not under consideration elsewhere, and all
authors will approve the submitted version. A blinded PDF, LaTeX source,
proof ledgers, and an exact standard-library supplement are available.

Sincerely,

[Author name, affiliation, and contact details]
